title: Grilling Techniques Class in Portland Oregon
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
Alcoholic beverages are only allowed to 18 years old and above.
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
I have been grilling and BBQing for over 20 years, and have trained abroad in France, Spain, Argentina, Thailand, South Korea and other countries. As a native of the American South, I combine my culinary roots with eclectic and diverse flavor profiles. The result is a completely unique approach to grilling, based on science that marries traditionally Southern recipes and techniques with exciting ethnic-inspired flavors. With over 350 classes delivered and a perfect 5 out of 5 stars rating, I know you will leave my kitchen as a better griller and overall cook! Let's get grilling y'all! 
Other classes include: Pasta Making, Paella Basics, Sushi 101, Pizza Making.
